title: Count the number of words in a file
summary: Use the wc command to count words in a text file. This helps estimate document length or check word counts for assignments.

steps.explain: Run wc with the --words flag followed by the path to your file. This prints the number of whitespace-separated words.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file you want to count words in

alternatives.explain: Use the short flag -w instead of --words.
